scenarios.title: Approved demo request
scenarios.syntheticData: org-test-a «مصرف تجريبي (أ)»; template AGE_OVER_18; holder TEST-001; national ID cred-test-001 (ACTIVE)
scenarios.start: Demo reset. Verifier (1366 px) on organisation A. Wallet (390 px) on home.
steps: Verifier creates the request through details → review → confirm
Wallet is notified and opens the request
Citizen reviews the selective-disclosure preview
Citizen approves and confirms
Verifier session page updates without reload
Both activity histories record the approval
scenarios.expected: Session DEMO_ACCEPTED; verifier shows «موافقة تجريبية — DEMO_ACCEPTED», the crypto layer «غير متحقق منه تشفيرياً», only the age claim; no protocol claim anywhere.
actual: created 3228DB (PENDING) via verifier UI
wallet home shows the pending request
disclosure preview: 1 shared, 3 withheld
verifier page updated live to DEMO_ACCEPTED
API: DEMO_ACCEPTED, disclosed keys = age_over_18
approval recorded in both activity histories

scenarios.title: Rejected request
scenarios.syntheticData: org-test-a; template IDENTITY_BASIC (3 fields); holder TEST-001
scenarios.start: Demo reset. Verifier on organisation A.
steps: Verifier creates an identity request in the UI
Verifier keeps the session page open
Citizen rejects in the wallet and confirms
Verifier session and results update
scenarios.expected: DEMO_REJECTED, disclosed = null, no values shown on the verifier, results «رفض» count 1, activity in both apps.
actual: citizen rejected in the wallet
verifier updated live; API DEMO_REJECTED, disclosed null
results and both activity histories show the rejection

scenarios.title: Expired session
scenarios.syntheticData: org-test-a; AGE_OVER_18; demo API started with DEMO_SESSION_TTL_MS=12000
scenarios.start: Demo reset. Request created; both apps open on it.
steps: Wallet and verifier keep the request open
TTL elapses without a decision
Citizen tries to decide late (API)
scenarios.expected: Both apps show «انتهت مهلة الطلب»; the wallet offers no approval; a late decision gets 409 SESSION_EXPIRED; state EXPIRED.
actual: both apps show the expiry
late decision → 409 SESSION_EXPIRED

scenarios.title: No browser console errors in either app during all scenarios
Duplicate decision
scenarios.syntheticData: org-test-a; AGE_OVER_18; two wallet tabs on the same request
scenarios.start: Demo reset. Tab 2 opened on the request, then its refresh is cut (stale view).
steps: Tab 1 approves
Stale tab 2 tries to reject
A direct API second decision is attempted
scenarios.expected: Tab 2 shows «لم يُسجَّل القرار»; the API returns 409 SESSION_ALREADY_DECIDED; the session stays DEMO_ACCEPTED with exactly one consent event.
actual: tab 1 approved
stale tab 2 reject refused and reported
API second decision → 409 SESSION_ALREADY_DECIDED; state DEMO_ACCEPTED; consent events 1

scenarios.title: Multiple organisations
scenarios.syntheticData: org-test-a «مصرف تجريبي (أ)» and org-test-b «شركة اتصالات تجريبية (ب)»; one request each
steps: Organisation A creates a request in the verifier UI
Organisation B creates one after switching organisation
Citizen approves A and rejects B
Each organisation views its sessions, results and activity
scenarios.expected: The wallet lists both with their names; A sees only its own session and outcome, B only its own; reading A's session as B is «غير موجود».
actual: A=6F78B3 (org-test-a), B=5DF6D4 (org-test-b)
org-test-a: own session only on sessions/results/activity; other session → not found
org-test-b: own session only on sessions/results/activity; other session → not found

scenarios.title: Network failure and recovery
scenarios.syntheticData: org-test-a; AGE_OVER_18; demo API calls blocked in the browser (route abort) and browser offline
scenarios.start: Demo reset. Request pending; verifier sessions list and wallet request open.
steps: API becomes unreachable for both apps
Citizen tries to approve during the outage
Service returns
Citizen approves
Browser goes offline, then back
scenarios.expected: Verifier keeps last data with a stale notice; the wallet decision fails visibly and the state stays PENDING; after recovery the decision succeeds and the verifier updates; offline disables decisions.
actual: verifier: stale notice, last data kept
wallet: decision during outage refused and reported
verifier recovered on its own
after recovery: approval recorded, verifier shows DEMO_ACCEPTED
browser offline: decisions disabled; restored when online

scenarios.title: Credential restrictions
scenarios.syntheticData: Demo API started with DEMO_CREDENTIAL_STATUS=SUSPENDED (national ID cred-test-001 SUSPENDED); org-test-a; AGE_OVER_18
scenarios.start: Demo restarted with the suspended credential, then reset (the status survives reset).
steps: Verifier creates a request
Citizen opens it in the wallet
Citizen (or a direct API call) tries to approve
Citizen rejects
scenarios.expected: Wallet explains «اعتماد الهوية التجريبي موقوف» and disables approval; API approval → 409 CREDENTIAL_NOT_ACTIVE with state still PENDING; rejection works and reaches the verifier.
actual: wallet: restriction explained, approval disabled
API approve → 409 CREDENTIAL_NOT_ACTIVE; state PENDING
rejection recorded and shown to the verifier

scenarios.title: Privacy preservation
scenarios.syntheticData: org-test-a; AGE_OVER_18 (1 of 4 national-ID claims); withheld synthetic values «1990-01-01», «TEST-DOC-0001», «مواطن تجريبي»
steps: Verifier requests age only
Citizen opens the request and the disclosure preview
Citizen approves
Verifier and API responses are inspected
scenarios.expected: The preview names withheld fields without their values; only «العمر فوق 18 سنة: نعم» reaches the verifier; no withheld value in the verifier page, session JSON or activity.
actual: preview: 1 shared value, 3 withheld fields named without values
verifier page, session JSON and activity contain only the age claim
